text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x provides financial aid.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
EconomicHardship(x) ::: x has difficulty caused by too little money or resources.
LivesInSingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FatherOutOfWorkForMoreThanYear(x) ::: x's father has been out of work for more than a year.
Premises:
ETS provides financial aid to those who prove economic hardship ::: ∀x (FinancialAid(x) → ProveHardship(x))
Economic hardship refers to difficulty caused by having too little money or resources ::: ∀x (EconomicHardship(x) → (TooLittleMoney(x) ∨ TooFewResources(x)))
Tom lives in a single-parent family ::: LivesInSingleParentFamily(tom)
His dad has been out of work for more than a year ::: FatherOutOfWorkForMoreThanYear(tom's father)
Conclusion:
Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test ::: ?
